messages:
Lena: Auditor asked for chain-of-custody for KMS key rotation artifacts + RBAC mapping for last 90 days. Can we confirm what we can export quickly? Need to respond by EOD.
Samir: We have rotation events in CloudTrail, key policy diffs in our artifact store, and approval comments in JIRA. Are they asking for key material? (we will NOT share key material)
Auditor_PwC: Not key material. We need evidence of rotation timestamps, approvers, and any related incident tickets. Also a mapping from identities that could decrypt to the workload/service.
Lena: OK plan: 1) export CloudTrail events for RotateKey, UpdateAlias, CreateGrant for the last 90 days. 2) pull JIRA tickets tagged kms-rotation + approval comments. 3) RBAC mapping: list IAM roles and k8s serviceaccounts with decrypt permissions. 4) produce a manifest CSV + sha256 checksums for each artifact.
Samir: For step 1, quick CLI I use: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z > rotate-events.json
```
That gives eventIds. Then we cross-reference CloudWatch logs for the API request/response.
ops_bot: export job queued: evidence-export-job-1719965432 started. ETA ~8m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Lena: @Samir can you run the IAM scan for roles/policies containing kms:Decrypt? I'll assemble the manifest.
Samir: Running now. I normally scan attached policies for the action string. Example: 
```
aws iam list-policies --scope Local --query 'Policies[].Arn' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws iam get-policy-version --policy-arn {} --version-id v1 | jq '.PolicyVersion.Document' | grep -B2 -A2 "kms:Decrypt"
```
Not perfect but gets us started. Will produce a filtered roles-with-kms.json.
Auditor_PwC: Also need mapping to EKS serviceaccounts (IRSA) so we can see which workloads assume those roles.
Samir: I have a small script that pulls k8s annotations for iam.amazonaws.com/role-arn across clusters and matches to role ARNs. Will attach mapping.csv.
Lena: Format requested: CSV columns: artifact_type, source, timestamp, evidence_file, sha256. Auditor prefers a single bundle + manifest.
Samir: Note: there was a vuln triage (CVE-2026-1234) on 2026-02-18 that triggered an out-of-band rotation on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abc-rot. Include incident ticket: PROJ-782.
Auditor_PwC: Include mitigation timeline and any post-rotation validation tests (successful decrypts). Screenshots are OK but logs are better.
Lena: ops_bot, when export finishes please drop a pre-signed link to the bundle and the manifest.
ops_bot: evidence-export-job-1719965432 completed: https://s3.internal.company/evidence/1719965432.tar.gz :lock: 
Samir: Uploaded rotate-events.json and mapping.csv to the bundle. Manifest row sample: 
```
artifact_type,source,timestamp,evidence_file,sha256
cloudtrail,cloudtrail-api,2026-02-18T14:23:01Z,rotate-events.json,2b7e151628aed2a6abf7158809cf4f3c
```
Samir: Full checksum for bundle: sha256: 2b7e151628aed2a6abf7158809cf4f3c. Also added a redaction_map.csv for any PII.
Lena: Drafting response to auditor now. Quick question: are we comfortable including full role ARNs in the artifacts? They are sensitive but auditors need them.
Auditor_PwC: Role ARNs are fine to include. Redact full user emails and replace with employee IDs in the delivered identity map. We may request verification linking username -> employee id.
Samir: I'll generate identity_map.csv and deliver it separately via the secure transfer channel (scp to secure host).
Lena: OK I'm attaching manifest + bundle link + redaction notes in reply. Will call out PROJ-782 and the validation logs. Any objections?
Samir: No objections. I also added a short note about our key rotation SOP and where the signing of the approval happens (JIRA comment + approver).
Auditor_PwC: Received bundle, starting validation. Might ping for an explanation of why the serviceaccount mapping shows role usage by the deployment 'feature-x'.
Samir: Happy to pair and walk through the IRSA mapping if needed. Available after 3pm.
Lena: Thanks team. Closing from our side once auditor acknowledges. :thumbsup:
